title_vi: Bartleby, người chép văn bản: Một câu chuyện phố Wall
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The narrator calls Bartleby anh and narrates him as anh ta (hắn only in anger); Bartleby says tôi/ông; Turkey is ông ta, Nippers anh ta.
decisions.rationale: Stable across all three drafting parts.

decisions.decision: The lawyer’s urbane, self-regarding irony and legal periphrasis are kept, including his inner debate addressed to himself (mình).
decisions.rationale: The story is told through his complacency.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Dash style unified across the drafting parts (spaced em dashes, 34 instances in 169–251).
Turkey’s running ‘With submission, sir’ restored to Xin lượng thứ, thưa ông; Nippers is anh ta throughout; quotation of ‘thà’ unified.
The Halls of Justice (Dinh Công lý) no longer share the name of the Court of Chancery.

‘In mercy’s name’ no longer a promise of justice; 188 ‘the foremost one’ not ‘the leader’; 11 compatriot; 89 doubled shroud; 117 awkward ‘chịu thà’; 171–172 self-address as mình; 234 grub-man’s ‘Your sarvant’.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: Tôi thà không làm thì hơn
alternatives: Tôi muốn không làm thì hơn
glossary.rationale: ‘thà … thì hơn’ carries ‘prefer’ and lets the word’s contagion through the office (Nippers, Turkey, the narrator) stay audible; clipped variants are clipped in Vietnamese too.

glossary.draft_rendering: Gà Tây / Kìm Cộng / Bánh Gừng
glossary.rationale: Nicknames translated, capitalised and unglossed, as the narrator explains them himself.

glossary.source_term: scrivener; Master in Chancery; the Tombs / Halls of Justice; Dead Letter Office
glossary.draft_rendering: người chép văn bản; Thẩm phán phụ tá; nhà ngục Tombs / Dinh Công lý; Phòng Thư Chết
glossary.rationale: Fixed across the three drafting parts; the Court of Chancery and the Halls of Justice are kept distinct.

witness_decision: Selected the complete text of Project Gutenberg #11231 (transcribed by Steve J. Nelson and Clara T. Nelson). Gutenberg does not identify the printed edition transcribed; the story was first published in Putnam’s Monthly Magazine, November–December 1853. Not collated with a print facsimile; italic emphasis is not preserved in plain canonical passages.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Turkey’s tipsy grammar and the grub-man’s dialect are only partly marked.
Master in Chancery rendered as Thẩm phán phụ tá, which suggests a judge rather than a court officer.

title_review.source_title: Bartleby, the Scrivener: A Story of Wall-Street
title_review.target_title: Bartleby, người chép văn bản: Một câu chuyện phố Wall
title_review.rationale: Bartleby, người chép văn bản: Một câu chuyện phố Wall keeps Melville’s subtitle and the body’s own term for scrivener.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The narrator’s self-introduction keeps its snug complacency.
Dead Letter Office coda and ‘Ôi Bartleby! Ôi nhân loại!’ keep their cadence.
